description: Calls the platform API with the call token the Gate hands a Built-in External Service.

get_me.description: Present a call token to the platform API and answer the statuses it got.

probe.description: me-twice: GET /api/v1/me twice with this call's token. keep: keep this call's token unused. me-with-kept: GET /api/v1/me with the token an earlier call kept. another-route: GET /api/v1/projects with this call's token.
